official.title: Seasonal Climate Outlook
official.english_core_text: However, the probabilistic forecast suggests a moderate to high probability of above-normal rainfall in most areas of western and northern Luzon, while a moderate probability of below normal is expected over most parts of the Visayas and northern Mindanao. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall conditions , which may lead to dry spells and droughts in some parts of the country. The SW monsoon is expected to persist during this period, bringing widespread and heavy rainfall to the western sections of Luzon and the Visayas. The rainfall forecast indicates generally near-normal rainfall conditions over most parts of the country, with above-normal rainfall expected in some areas of western Northern Luzon.

official.title: Monthly Climate Assessment and Outlook
official.english_core_text: Based on observed rainfall during the past months and the forecast for September, meteorological drought/dry spells are likely to be experienced by the end of the month in Camarines Sur, and dry condition over some areas in Southern Mindanao. This is supported by the probabilistic forecast, suggesting a high chance of below-normal rainfall in the northern part of Luzon and some areas in Southern Mindanao and near to above-normal rainfall for the rest of Luzon, Visayas, and the rest of Mindanao. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall, which may lead to adverse climate impacts, including dry spells and droughts in some areas of the country. The rainfall assessment for the month showed that most areas in Luzon experienced above-normal conditions except Bicol Region, and most of Western Visayas, while below to way-below normal rainfall for the rest of the country.
